gear_sets.overview: Six core gear sets: three base sets and three S-Ranked counterparts. Only S-Ranked gear can be upgraded past Legendary.
gear_sets.gear_slots: Six gear slots per hero: Helmet, Armor, Weapon, Boots, Ring, Amulet.
gear_sets.loadouts: Every player has 8 saved loadouts they can name and configure freely. Loadouts are player-level slots, not hero-level — they persist independent of which hero is selected.

set_pairs.destruction: Base set, caps at Legendary. S-Ranked counterpart: Dragoon.
set_pairs.decisiveness: Base set, caps at Legendary. S-Ranked counterpart: Griffin.
set_pairs.echo: Base set, caps at Legendary. S-Ranked counterpart: Oracle.

gear_sets.s_ranked_indicator: S-Ranked pieces show a yellow 'S' badge on the gear icon (it can read as a '5' at small sizes).
gear_sets.s_ranked_source: S-Ranked gear (Dragoon / Griffin / Oracle) drops directly from Mythstone Chest and Chromatic Chest. You do not build them up from base set pieces.
gear_sets.s_ranked_minimum_rarity: S-Ranked gear never drops at Common, Fine, or Rare. The lowest rarity an S-Ranked piece can drop at is Epic; from there it can be upgraded to Chaotic.
gear_sets.rarity_ladder_note: 14 rarity tiers, low to high, ending at Chaotic.
gear_sets.base_set_cap: Base sets (Destruction / Decisiveness / Echo) can be upgraded through Legendary +3 but cannot reach Mythic or beyond.
gear_sets.s_ranked_cap: S-Ranked sets (Dragoon / Griffin / Oracle) can be upgraded all the way to Chaotic.
gear_sets.base_set_fodder: Past early game, base set pieces have no long-term upgrade ceiling, so most players use them as upgrade fodder for S-Ranked pieces.
gear_sets.gear_levels: Each gear piece has a Level counter from 1 to 200, upgraded with slot-specific Gear Scrolls (Weapon Scroll for weapons, Armor Scroll for armor, etc.).
gear_sets.gear_scroll_sources: Gear Scrolls drop from Hunt and are sold in the Daily Shop and as Reach milestone rewards.
gear_sets.levels_vs_rarity: Gear level and rarity are independent progression tracks. Level grows to 200 via Gear Scrolls; rarity is upgraded separately at the Blacksmith. They do not affect each other.
gear_sets.upgrade_costs: Rarity upgrades cost Gold plus slot-specific Scrolls.
gear_sets.piece_detail_fields: A gear piece's detail screen shows name + rarity tier, level X/200, Skin Skills (set-specific abilities) and Quality Skills (stat bonuses).
gear_sets.stat_snapshot_caveat: Per-piece stats below were captured at the Chaotic rarity tier. Lower rarities show a subset of these effects, and flat values scale with the piece's level.

griffin_set.theme: Theme observed: proximity / melee-range bonuses — multiple 'more enemies in melee range' effects, closer-distance DMG and CRIT bonuses, a 7m damage-over-time aura, and dodge while moving. Reads as a close-range crowd-fighting set. (Contributor flagged this as an interpretation to confirm.)
griffin_set.recurring_pattern: Every Griffin piece has: a flat primary stat (ATK PWR on offensive slots, Max HP on defensive slots), a matching % primary stat, a slot-flavored secondary stat, [Slot]'s base stats +20% / +30% / +40% as three tiered upgrades, and one or two conditional effects that scale by rarity (the second tier roughly doubles the first).

Reads as a sustained ranged DPS combo build, the opposite identity from Griffin.

dragoon_set.status: Per-piece Dragoon detail was not documented in this contribution. The contributor notes Dragoon follows the same pattern as Griffin and Oracle: 6 pieces (Helmet / Armor / Weapon / Boots / Ring / Amulet) each with flat + % primary stats, a slot-flavored secondary, base-stat tiers, and conditional effects.

weapon_skins.scope: Skins exist only for the main weapon. There are no skins for Helmet, Armor, Boots, Ring, or Amulet. Only one weapon skin can be equipped at a time.
weapon_skins.weapon_archetypes: Three base weapon archetypes, each with multiple skins: Crossbow (Heroic Longbow family), Staff (Beam Staff family), and Claw (Agile Knuckles / Griffin Claw family).
weapon_skins.two_layers: Each skin has two layers with different activation rules: Collectible Stats and Skin Skills.
weapon_skins.collectible_stats: Static and always active once you own the skin, whether or not it is equipped. Owning more skins stacks their Collectible Stats permanently across the account.
weapon_skins.skin_skills: Only active while that skin is equipped. The active ability proc (Snowball, Lacerate DoT, Cudgel Jab, summoned hoops, etc.) only triggers on the currently equipped skin.
weapon_skins.star_upgrades: Every skin has 6 effective tiers: an 'owned' baseline (0 stars) plus 1 star through 5 stars. You upgrade only by acquiring duplicate skins — each duplicate is one star. There is no currency-based upgrade path.
weapon_skins.star_benefits: Higher stars give stronger Collectible Stats (bigger per-piece-equipped bonuses) and stronger Skin Skills (more damage, procs, and stacks).
weapon_skins.skin_rarity: Skins have their own rarities; icon background color is a tell (purple-magenta = lower, gold-yellow = higher). Higher-rarity skins give bigger Collectible Stats at every star tier. More rarity tiers exist beyond these two, with different ratios; the full ladder was not captured.

collectible_stats_gold_rarity.note: Per matching-set gear piece equipped, for higher-rarity (gold icon) skins such as Holly Blitz, Cosmic Hoop, Monarch's Fang.

collectible_stats_purple_rarity.note: Per matching-set gear piece equipped, for lower-rarity (purple icon) skins such as Shadesteal Claw.

weapon_skins.set_tie: Each skin is tied to a specific gear set (Griffin / Dragoon / Oracle). Its Collectible Stats only count matching-set gear — equipping a Griffin skin while wearing Oracle gear means the Collectible Stats have nothing to count.
weapon_skins.acquisition: Hero Skin Shop is the primary source; Reforger Shop is an alternative source/exchange. The skin tooltip header reads 'Skin Exchange Shop'.
weapon_skins.strategy: Two different priorities: Collectible Stats reward breadth (owning many skins, even at low stars, builds a permanent passive power floor), while Skin Skills reward depth (level your best equipped skin to 5 stars via duplicates).

monarchs_fang.skin_skill: Main weapon attacks inflict Lacerate on enemies hit for 5s, dealing X% Weapon DMG every 0.5s. When Lacerated enemies are defeated there is a Y% chance to drop Red Hearts.

eldritch_tower.collectible_stats: Standard gold-rarity progression: ATK +20 to +100, HP +80 to +400 across Owned through 5 stars.

weapon_skins.oracle_skin_note: The Oracle weapon shows as 'Oracle Spear' on the gear page, but skins re-render it as different visual weapons (cudgels, towers). The underlying archetype is likely Staff. Oracle skins follow the same rules as Griffin skins.

hero_stat_sheet.core: Total ATK, Total HP, ATK PWR, ATK Bonus %, Max HP, HP Bonus %, MOV SPD %, ATK SPD %
hero_stat_sheet.crit: CRIT Rate, CRIT DMG, CRIT DMG REDUC, Reduced Crit DMG from Players (PvP-specific)
hero_stat_sheet.defense: Dodge, Effect RES, DMG REDUC, Final DMG REDUC, plus per-context values for Barrage, Collision, Airborne, Ground, Minion, Elite, Boss
hero_stat_sheet.offense: Final DMG Bonus, more damage vs airborne / ground / minions / elites, Boss DMG, Main Weapon DMG (flat + %), Main Weapon CRIT Rate
hero_stat_sheet.elemental: Poison DMG (flat), Lightning DMG (flat + %), Flame DMG %, Fire DMG (flat)
hero_stat_sheet.healing: Heal on Level Up, Red Heart Heal %, Heart Recovery %, Angel Recovery %
hero_stat_sheet.flat_and_percent_note: Most stats appear as both a flat + and a percentage variant and the game stacks both. Higher-tier gear and runes mostly contribute to the % multipliers.
